FROM cdc_system.shadow_binding sb
		JOIN cdc_system.source_object_registry so
		  ON so.id = sb.source_object_id
		LEFT JOIN cdc_system.connection_registry cn
		  ON cn.id = so.source_connection_id
		LEFT JOIN cdc_system.cdc_table_registry tr
		  ON COALESCE(NULLIF(so.source_schema, ''), so.source_database) = tr.source_db
		 AND tr.source_table = so.source_object_name
		 AND tr.target_table = sb.shadow_table
		LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
			SELECT
				rr.diff,
				rr.checked_at
			FROM cdc_system.cdc_reconciliation_report rr
			WHERE rr.shadow_table = sb.shadow_table
			ORDER BY rr.checked_at DESC
			LIMIT 1
		) rr ON TRUE
		LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
			SELECT status, rows_affected, total_rows, trace_id, job_id, error_message
